title: onlyne-swarm workspace template
description: Full starter template for .agents/.schedule/<name>/template.workspace.jsonc. Every key ships with its default; delete anything unchanged.

$schema.description: Editor hint pointing at this schema file. Ignored by the scheduler.

name.description: Workspace name. Defaults to the template directory name when empty.

role.description: Inline system prompt delivered to the session before the task payload.

model.description: Session launcher metadata kept verbatim in the merged snapshot.

back_edges.description: Callback targets as tree paths, relative to this workspace. Cyclic edges are allowed; missing targets fail sync.
